description: Approximate daily one-way prices between two places for about three weeks from a start date, or through an end date in one call, within the next two months, with the cheapest days. Prices come from recent searches, not live fares. Use when the user asks which day is cheapest to fly, or for prices across many days, instead of a flight_search per day. Dates are DD.MM.YYYY. For a period longer than about three weeks, pass start_date and end_date in one call: each call shows its own card and only the last one stays visible, so do not chain calls for one question. The calendar covers about two months from today; if the returned days end before end_date, tell the user that later dates need a flight_search for a specific day. Use next_start_date only when the user later asks for further dates. Prices are approximate, from recent searches: once the user picks a day, run flight_search for that day for the live price and the booking flow.

end_date.description: Last day in DD.MM.YYYY format: returns start_date through this day in one call (at most about two months from today)

start_date.description: First day in DD.MM.YYYY format (default: today)

name: flight_price_calendar
